rules.requirement: Preserve every points.json id without invention, renumbering, merging, or omission.
rules.fix: Restore physical navigation IDs from the authoritative point export.

rules.requirement: Keep distinct logical points separate even when their coordinates and yaw are equal or near.
rules.fix: Confirm every shared-pose point role with the user.

rules.requirement: Use only fields defined by the bundled tour_robot target schemas.
rules.fix: Remove unknown fields or select the real runtime field from the model catalog.

rules.requirement: The directory basename and every YAML scene_id must be the same lowercase snake_case value.
rules.fix: Rename the directory and align all scene_id values.

rules.requirement: Every Explain Point map_point must exist and its point_id must equal the referenced map point point_id.
rules.fix: Use the confirmed logical map key and authoritative physical ID.

rules.requirement: Every Segment must contain non-empty narration and remain within the configured per-point limit.
rules.fix: Restore source-derived content or split it across confirmed Explain Points.

rules.requirement: Every Program Explain Point key must exist and appear once.
rules.fix: Correct the execution list using existing Explain Point keys.

rules.requirement: Place the confirmed welcome point first and farewell point last, preserving the user-confirmed physical visit order.
rules.fix: Correct the Program order after user confirmation.

rules.requirement: Every intended Explain Point must be reachable through at least one Program.
rules.fix: Add unreachable points to the intended Program or remove intentionally unused narration.

rules.requirement: Set a valid confirmed photo_point and never enable photo_before_explain and photo_after_explain together.
rules.fix: Use a confirmed map point and one explicit photo policy.

rules.requirement: Program point count and estimated duration must stay within declared limits.
rules.fix: Revise the route or confirm and update the declared limits.

rules.requirement: Account for every source section as included, explicitly omitted, or unresolved.
rules.fix: Restore omitted source content or obtain explicit approval for omission.

rules.requirement: Preserve names, figures, dates, qualifications, quotations, and conclusions from the source.
rules.fix: Correct the narration from exact source references.

rules.requirement: Do not invent spatial directions, gestures, accessibility, robot capabilities, audiences, or runtime behavior.
rules.fix: Remove the invention or obtain authoritative input and confirmation.

rules.requirement: Declare a scene import-ready only when validation returns is_publishable true with zero errors and zero warnings.
rules.fix: Resolve all diagnostics and rerun the complete validation SOP.
